bhairavastava: I wonder how suffering can be fully acknowledged, yet fear be absolutely absent…
pancashloki: I wonder what it means to offer pride itself — and call that the only duty…
anubhavanivedana: I wonder how a sound, a posture, a breath can already be perfect…
paramarthacarca: I wonder how difference can be real, yet never cut off from its ground…
anuttarastika: I wonder how staying still can itself be the method…
ghatakarpara: I wonder why a Jain monk's wager turns on a single cloud…
spandasandoha: I wonder what it means for the inner face to taste…
sivastotravali: I wonder how praise itself becomes the offering…
